kibicomputers.configuration.title: KiBi Computers Configuration
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.to: Threads and server-wide limits. Changes take effect when the world is next opened.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ma: Maximum number of computers running WebAssembly at the same time. 0 = automatic (half of the CPU threads, at least 1).
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.th: Stack size of each kernel thread, in KiB. Only reserved; memory is used as needed.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.ma: Maximum number of blocking processes (each uses a dedicated thread) on the whole server.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.co: Number of low-priority threads that load (instrument and compile) programs.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.pr: Number of loaded programs kept in memory even when no computer uses them.
Total WebAssembly size of the unused programs kept in memory, in MiB.
kibicomputers.configuration.scheduler.to: Total RAM limit for all computers on the server, in MiB. 0 = automatic (half of the maximum JVM heap).
kibicomputers.configuration.save.autosav: Interval between autosaves of running computers, in ticks. Raised to at least autosaveQuiesceTicks + 2 (a shorter interval would close computers before they are written).
Ticks an autosave waits for a computer to reach a safe point.
Maximum number of computers captured for autosave per tick.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.unloadW: Total time per tick spent waiting for computers in unloading chunks to reach a safe point, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.stopQui: Time the server waits on shutdown for all computers to reach a safe point, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.fullSav: Write a full save instead of a delta when more than this fraction of the rewritten pages changed from the base.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.writerM: Maximum total size of saves waiting to be written, in MiB. Above this, autosaves are postponed.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.writerF: Maximum time to wait for the save writer thread (on shutdown and when the pending limit is reached), in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.save.restore: Maximum number of computers whose restore starts per tick when chunks load.
Maximum time a restore waits for a pending save of the same computer; after that it cold-boots, in milliseconds.
kibicomputers.configuration.screenSync.p: Maximum screen update traffic sent to one player, in bytes per second.
kibicomputers.configuration.screenSync.s: Maximum screen update traffic sent to all players together, in bytes per second.
kibicomputers.configuration.keyboard.inp: Burst size of keyboard input a computer accepts, in bytes. Applies to keyboards opened after a change.
Keyboard input allowance restored per tick, in bytes. Applies to keyboards opened after a change.
